title: Civil Code, Division 3, Part 4, Title 5, Chapter 2 (Hiring of Real Property)
verified_how: Fetched the CIV Div 3 Part 4 expanded branch: 'TITLE 5. HIRING 1925-1997.270', 'CHAPTER 2. Hiring of Real Property 1940-1954.071'. §1941 is current.
notes: Residential tenancy: habitability, security deposits (§1950.5), the Tenant Protection Act rent cap and just cause (§§1946.2, 1947.12). Unlawful detainer procedure is in the Code of Civil Procedure §1159 onward, which I did not verify.
